desc: Derive closed form f(i,x) = x/((i+1)(x-1)) for Pr[x ∈ subtree(i)] and the case split for edge-on-path probability
Derive per-query aggregation formula with prefix sums P1, P2 and boundary terms i=u, i=v
Implement modular precomputations: inv[1..N+1] (linear O(N)), P1/P2 prefix sums, (N-1)! mod 998244353
Implement solve() with fast I/O, O(1) per query, guarding edge cases u=1, v=u+1, N=2
Validate against the three samples and brute-force enumeration for N ≤ 7 random tests
